verses.text: The LORD said to Moses,
"Speak to the whole community of Israel and tell them: Be holy, because I, the LORD your God, am holy.
Each of you must respect your mother and your father, and keep my Sabbath days. I am the LORD your God.
Do not turn to idols, and do not make metal statues of gods for yourselves. I am the LORD your God.
When you offer a peace offering to the LORD, offer it in the right way, so that it will be accepted for you.
It must be eaten on the day you offer it or on the next day. Anything left over until the third day must be burned in the fire.
If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is disgusting and will not be accepted.
Whoever eats it will carry the blame, because he has treated what is holy to the LORD as ordinary. That person must be cut off from his people.
When you gather the harvest of your land, do not harvest all the way to the edges of your field, and do not go back to pick up the grain that was dropped.
Do not strip your vineyard bare, and do not pick up the grapes that have fallen. Leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.
Do not steal. Do not lie. Do not cheat one another.
Do not make a false promise using my name, and so dishonour the name of your God. I am the LORD.
Do not treat your neighbour unfairly or rob him. Do not keep back a hired worker's pay overnight until morning.
Do not curse a deaf person, and do not put something in front of a blind person to make him trip. Instead, fear your God. I am the LORD.
Do not be unfair when you judge. Do not favour the poor or show special respect to the powerful. Judge your neighbour fairly.
Do not go around spreading lies about your people. Do not put your neighbour's life in danger. I am the LORD.
Do not hate your brother in your heart. Correct your neighbour openly when he is wrong, so that you do not share in his sin.
Do not take revenge or hold a grudge against anyone among your people. Instead, love your neighbour as you love yourself. I am the LORD.
Keep my rules. Do not breed two different kinds of animals together. Do not plant your field with two kinds of seed. Do not wear clothes made of two kinds of material.

If a man has sexual relations with a slave woman who is promised to marry another man, but who has not been bought back or set free, they must be punished. But they are not to be put to death, because she was not free.
The man must bring a ram to the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting as a guilt offering.
With the ram of the guilt offering, the priest will make him right with God in front of the LORD for the sin he has done, and his sin will be forgiven.
When you come into the land and plant any kind of fruit tree, treat its fruit as forbidden. For three years it is forbidden to you and must not be eaten.
In the fourth year all its fruit will be holy, a gift of praise to the LORD.
In the fifth year you may eat its fruit, so that the tree will give you more and more. I am the LORD your God.
Do not eat any meat with the blood still in it. Do not use magic or try to tell the future.
Do not cut the hair on the sides of your head or trim the edges of your beard.
Do not cut your bodies to mourn for the dead, and do not put tattoos on yourselves. I am the LORD.
Do not dishonour your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will turn to prostitution and be filled with evil.
Keep my Sabbath days and respect my holy place. I am the LORD.
Do not turn to people who talk with the dead or to fortune-tellers. Do not go to them, or they will make you unclean. I am the LORD your God.
Stand up in the presence of old people, and show respect to the elderly. Fear your God. I am the LORD.
When a foreigner lives with you in your land, do not treat him badly.
Treat the foreigner living with you like someone born among you. Love him as you love yourself, because you were foreigners in Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
Do not cheat when you measure length, weight, or amount.
Use honest scales, honest weights, and honest measures for dry and liquid things. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt.
Keep all my rules and all my laws, and obey them. I am the LORD."
